findings.title: The first output guard was attached to provisioning, not the result branch

findings.title: The initial beyond-inline marker lacked the detector's required word boundary
findings.observed: The generated suffix followed word characters and was not a canonical detector match. A separate controlled probe then exposed the real JSON newline/Unicode transport escape. The first end-to-end attempt emitted inside pytest capture; its unexpected PASS made the attack premise false. Process-exit emission now bypasses capture without changing the closed runner.
findings.requiredCorrection: Assert canonical recognition of the generated bytes before execution, use a real separator, and preserve JSON transport detection at the shared scanner.

findings.title: Sandbox output reaches durable transport and full-output artifacts before evaluator secret containment
findings.observed: The real sandbox service decision path returns SUCCEEDED with canonical synthetic credential-shaped output. Its full-output branch writes artifacts before returning the execution to the Temporal activity. Evaluator-only scanning therefore does not cover the first durable boundary. Cmd-0107 exposed nested JSON embedded in ordinary pytest output: whole-document decoding alone still permitted the inline marker into history. Mixed-stream fragment parsing and bounded parser-work refusal are now covered by regression; the failed proof is preserved.
findings.requiredCorrection: Scan exact structured output and decoded full streams before any sandbox artifact write or activity response; fail closed on scanner failure; retain a clean positive control and reject without retaining prohibited bytes. Re-run complete verification for the corrected subject.

findings.title: Durable cancellation can race result and verdict finalization

findings.requiredCorrection: Recover from cancellation races using authoritative state, fail closed at verdict persistence, and serialize cancellation against immutable verdict commitment. Prove both arrival orders and preserve unrelated failures.

The real published v1 self-evaluation subsequently reproduced FAILED Temporal workflow / RUNNING API state with a cancelled iacode_quality_read_run cause and no pending activities. This preserves the actual mechanism without claiming recovery of attempt 2's original history.
findings.requiredCorrection: Obtain bounded real history diagnostics before cleanup, determine and correct the cause without increasing deadlines or weakening the control, then repeat the complete proof. Unit success does not replace that live requirement.
